dedupe_keys.name: doe 2 and equest building energy simulation

description: DOE-2 is a building energy simulation program developed by James J. Hirsch & Associates in collaboration with Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, largely with U.S. Department of Energy funding; DOE2.com is the developer's site and is not endorsed by DOE or LBNL. eQUEST, the most current complete tool, is freeware that bundles DOE-2.2 and its documentation with building creation wizards, an energy efficiency measure wizard and graphical results, so that users can compare designs without deep modelling experience. The latest release is eQUEST 3.65, and the eQ_WthProc utility converts EnergyPlus EPW weather into DOE-2 binary files. The site also compares DOE-2.1E, DOE-2.2, eQUEST and PowerDOE. Coverage: generic. Access: free download of eQUEST. Licence: freeware. Caveats: DOE-2.2 is an older engine, and the site states it is not endorsed by DOE or LBNL. Simulation uses: whole-building energy comparisons for design and code compliance studies. Related records: EnergyPlus and GenOpt.
